title: Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon 2026 Review: 33 Editions of Coastal Racing
seo_title: Pattaya Marathon 33rd Edition 2026 Review | Thailand Race
meta_description: The Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon (33rd ed.) 2026: September 27 in Pattaya. 42K, 21K, 10K, 4.5K with registration open — three decades of Thailand's beach-city marathon reviewed.
dek: Set for 27 September 2026 in Pattaya, Chonburi, this 33rd-edition marathon offers four distances with registration open. Three decades of history at one of Thailand's most established beach-city races.
verdict: The Amazing Thailand Pattaya Marathon has been running for 33 editions — an extraordinary achievement that places it among Thailand's longest-running road races. Four distances (42K, 21K, 10K, 4.5K) with registration open. Pattaya's coastal roads, tourist infrastructure, and proximity to Bangkok (roughly 1.5 hours) make it one of Thailand's most accessible destination marathons. The September date sits in the late rainy season — expect warm, humid conditions with possible showers. For runners wanting a beach-city Thai marathon with three decades of history and open registration, this is a strong pick.
